title: Korean Skincare Routine for Oily Skin in India

quick: For oily skin in India, keep the Korean basics but use fewer, lighter steps: a gel cleanser, one layer of hydrating toner, a light serum, a gel moisturiser and SPF 30 sunscreen. At night, double cleanse and use a thin layer of night cream.
